entries.text_de: Liber pontificalis Beccensis monasterii, 12/13. Jh. Hieraus edirte Martène Iudicia Dei XII; aus ihm drucken Zeumer und ich S. 417. 420; vgl. 401b.
entries.text_en: Pontifical of the monastery of Bec, 12th/13th century. From this Martène edited Iudicia Dei XII; from him Zeumer and I print them, pp. 417. 420; cf. 401b.

transcription.doubts: Superscript italic 'b' is a letter mark, not a footnote number. 'Liber pontificalis Beccensis' letter-spaced in print (cf. note on Ant).
